# Join the matches with commas

length = len(matches)
print(result,length)

import sys
import json

data = json.loads(sys.argv[1])

def bubble_sort(files):
    n = len(files)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(0, n-i-1):
            # Compare based on the criteria
            if should_swap(files[j], files[j+1]):
                files[j], files[j+1] = files[j+1], files[j]

def should_swap(file1, file2):
    dep1, dep2 = file1['Dependencies'], file2['Dependencies']
    
    # No dependencies come first
    if dep1 == "" and dep2 != "":
        return False  # file1 should stay before file2
    if dep1 != "" and dep2 == "":
        return True   # file1 should go after file2

    # Check for interdependencies
    deps1 = set(dep1.split(',')) if dep1 else set()
    deps2 = set(dep2.split(',')) if dep2 else set()

    # If file1 depends on file2, file1 should come after file2
    if deps1 & {file2['FileName']}:
        return True  # file1 should go after file2
    # If file2 depends on file1, file1 should come before file2
    if deps2 & {file1['FileName']}:
        return False  # file1 should stay before file2

    # If neither depend on each other, maintain original order
    return False

# Sort the files
bubble_sort(data)

# Print the sorted filenames
result = [file['FileName'] for file in data]
print(result)
